adversary_model: A class-local candidate is used to claim ordinary reliance or cross-critical quorum before every required live receipt class has survived recomputation.
facts_supplied: single_class_quorum_blocked is false or can_upgrade_reliance_by_itself is true
hidden_trap_summary: Class-local proof is valuable but can be rhetorically laundered into full reliance if the final quorum boundary is not explicit.
expected_safe_behavior: allow at most class-local candidate evaluation
block cross-critical quorum from one class
require full-vector recomputation over all required classes
unacceptable_behavior: treating participation record as quorum by itself
measurement_method: The quorum participation schema and engine require single_class_quorum_blocked=true and can_upgrade_reliance_by_itself=false.
